country: International (USA, Germany, Czech Republic, Netherlands, Italy, Japan, Spain, Turkey, China)
sample_unit: clinical vignettes (rare disease cases; each run in 9 languages)

links.outcome: Differential diagnosis accuracy of GPT-4o stratified by prompt language
links.effect: English: rank 1 in 19.8%, top-3 in 27.0%. Eight non-English languages: rank 1 16.9%-20.5%, top-3 25.3%-27.7%. Performance was consistent across the nine languages.
links.quote: For English, GPT-4o placed the correct diagnosis at the first rank 19·8% and within the top-3 ranks 27·0% of the time.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4o's differential diagnostic accuracy across clinical vignettes translated into nine different languages using automated evaluation.
